name: Fourth Generation Information Systems Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1998, Fourth Generation Information Systems Ltd is an IT and ITES provider[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
FGISL is a Hardware & Software Product development, consulting technology services and outsourcing company. It is in the business of providing Information Technology and IT enabled services in India. Currently, the company is exploring opportunities in the area of hardware-based software products. It is planning to venture and develop expertise in such areas.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 1,086 to 104 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 73.0% of their holding.
